_comment_project: SOVEREIGN PROBABILITY ENGINE — STAGE 3: DATASET FACTORY (PART E)
_comment_purpose: Canonical Apache Arrow / Polars / PyArrow schema contracts for Stage 4A Continual Pre-Training (CPT), Stage 4B Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), and Stage 5 Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO Brier + CLOB Edge RL).
_comment_security: Strictly separates PROMPT_VISIBLE input features from TARGET_MASKED_FOR_REWARD ground-truth labels so target outcomes never leak into model input prompts.
